about_the_game:
A nostalgic arcade-style shooter with a galactic twist.

In this retro-inspired space adventure, you’ll pilot your ship through handcrafted levels, battling rival AI fleets and capturing planets to dominate the galaxy. Avoid crashing into celestial bodies while fending off enemies who are also racing to expand their control.

Each level is designed for quick, thrilling sessions packed with strategic depth and pixel-perfect chaos. Whether you're conquering planets or fighting for survival, the challenge is always on.

👾 Key Highlights:

  • 🚀 Fast space combat with unique controls

  • 🌍 Planet conquest gameplay

  • 🎨 Classic pixel art style with modern polish

  • 🤖 Enemy AI that hunts you and conquers planets

  • 🎯 Carefully crafted levels

  • 🌑 Avoid planetary collisions while battling in orbit

  • 🕒 Designed for short, satisfying gameplay sessions

  • 🕹️ Controller support planned

Get ready to conquer the stars, one pixel at a time.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be enough
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: If the game runs slowly for you, feel free to contact me so I can update this.
